title: Azaae shaah ke aaye zamaane
body:
Azaae shaah ke aaye zamaane
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
utar aaye malak aankhei'n bichaane
<<MINI>>
Azaae shaah ke aaye zamaane
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka (2)
Azaae shaah ke aaye zamaane
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Hui aamad shahedee'n ki dakan me
hai maatam shaah ka haar anjuman me
qiza chaati hai ahmad ke chaman me
<<MINI>>
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Hue hai karbala waale jo mehmaa'n
aza-e-shaah ke hote hai saamaa'n
karo tum chaak apne ab garebaa'n
<<MINI>>
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Ye kaisi rounaqe bazme azaa hai
ye dunya kis ke gham me ghamzada hai
yahi maatam zamaane ki baqa hai
<<MINI>>
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Tamanna-e-dile zainab yahi hai
yahi to haasile sad zindagi hai
yahi nusrat ghame shabbir ki hai
<<MINI>>
karo maatam shahe mazloom ka
